title: Agent Handshake terms
description: The dev.handshake/terms extension: plans, scopes and limits for one MCP server. Gateways publish it in the server card at _meta["dev.handshake/terms"]. Spec version 0.1. Unknown properties are allowed, so newer gateways can add fields.

specVersion.title: Spec version
specVersion.description: Version of this terms format. This schema describes 0.1.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: Base URL of the gateway that enforces these terms.

install.title: Install page
install.description: Page where a person adds this server to their agent.

manage.title: Manage page
manage.description: Page where a person sees, upgrades or removes their tools.

defaultPlan.title: Default plan
defaultPlan.description: Id of the plan new installs start on. One of the plan ids in plans.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: What each scope lets the agent do, keyed by scope name. Empty when the server has no scopes.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Plans a person can be on.

uninstall.title: Uninstall
uninstall.description: How a host removes the server.

revocationEndpoint.title: Revocation endpoint
revocationEndpoint.description: OAuth token revocation endpoint (RFC 7009). Revoking the host's token removes the connection.

url.title: URL
url.description: An absolute http:// or https:// URL.

planId.title: Plan id
planId.description: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores.

description.title: Scope description
description.description: What this scope lets the agent do, in plain words.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: One plan: free, a free trial, paid, or pay per call.

id.title: Plan id
id.description: Short id of the plan, like trial or pro.

price.title: Price
price.description: 0 for free (also for pay-per-call plans), or an object with amount, currency and interval.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Price in whole currency units, like 9 or 9.99.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code in capitals, like USD.

interval.title: Billing interval
interval.description: How often it is charged. Missing means a one-time payment.

durationDays.title: Length in days
durationDays.description: Days the plan lasts. Missing means no end.

calls.title: Call limit
calls.description: Most tool calls allowed per period.

period.title: Period
period.description: When the counts reset: total (never), day, or month (every 30 days). Missing means total.

spendUsd.title: Spend limit
spendUsd.description: Most USD the plan may spend per period. 0 means no payment is ever taken.

scopes.title: Plan scopes
scopes.description: Scopes this plan unlocks. "*" means every tool.

checkoutUrl.title: Checkout URL
checkoutUrl.description: Where to send a person to buy this plan. Set on paid plans that are not pay per call.

x402.title: Pay per call (x402)
x402.description: Set when the agent pays for each call with x402.

pricePerCall.title: Price per call
pricePerCall.description: USD per call as a decimal string, like "0.01".

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: Token the agent pays with, like USDC.

network.title: Network
network.description: Chain to pay on, as a CAIP-2 id, like eip155:8453 (Base).
